title: Managed Database: primary usage pricing
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database primary usage pricing applies to database charge. This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source type; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in database service meters take priority. For source type primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source type values. Use the tier recorded for each source service interval. Read standard unit rate and regional usage multipliers for primary usage. Allocate included quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in service interval start then original source reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month. Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged. Allocate committed quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines. The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive reservation discounts; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary. For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in discount priority: an approved negotiated rate when negotiated rate allowed, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from promotion channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard. The negotiated rate replaces the primary standard unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount. Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive. Round the final service subtotal using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply tax calculation. No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits. Record effective price component for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity. Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

## Evidence: posted meter
For source type primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source type values. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, status, service interval start, service interval end. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference. 

## Quantity and price treatment
| Stage | Treatment of the primary source quantity |
|---|---|
| Included allowance | Allocate in service-start and original-reference order; charge only positive excess |
| Commitment | Allocate in the same order and distinguish covered from uncovered invoice lines |
| Effective price | Select the first applicable priority entry for each quantity component |
| Negotiated unit rate | Replace the standard rate before the regional multiplier; apply no further discount |
| Service rounding | Round after quantity multiplication, before tax |

## Price-priority case
Hypothetical condition case: a quantity component has an approved permitted negotiated rate and also a recorded eligible promotion. The negotiated rate replaces the standard unit rate before the regional multiplier and receives no promotional discount. Applying both would contradict the explicit no-further-discount rule.
